Neblina · V0.5

What happens to a dataset

Drop a research dataset and watch the real pipeline read it: screened for direct identifiers before anything is parsed, then its own data dictionary, then every column resolved against a curated ontology. Nothing is stored, and the file never leaves this process.

Unlisted preview. This page runs the real V0.5 engine against a file you choose, and keeps nothing: uploads are read in a temporary directory that is deleted when the request finishes. It does not write to any warehouse and holds no credentials. Published research datasets are the intended input.

Drop a dataset here

CSV, Excel, Stata, SPSS or Parquet. Nothing is kept.

Structural gateShape only — extension, size, not an archive. The file is not opened.
Direct-identifier tripwireEvery row of every populated sheet, offline. A study number passes; a personnummer does not.
CodebookWhat the study itself says its columns mean.
Profile and mapType, missingness, qualifier slots, then cosine similarity against 155 curated labels at a 0.65 threshold.

Which table did you mean?


    

    
Every sheet was screened for identifiers. Only the choice of which one to profile is open — one study is one table, and guessing here is how a file gets read from the wrong tab in silence.

  


  

    
Refused

    

    
The run stopped here. Nothing was profiled, no description was generated, and no column ever reached a model. The report names columns and classes and quotes no values, so it is safe to store and safe to email.

  


  


    

      

      

      

    


    

      
The data dictionary

      

    


    

      
Every column

      
What the pipeline knows about each column, and what it declined to claim. An empty qualifier means the file did not say — which a join needs to know, and is not the same as the dimension not applying.

      

        
ColumnTypeFrom the codebookQualifiersOntology labelConf.

        

    


    

      
Same-label collisions

      
Two non-identical columns landing on one label means either a mapping is wrong or the ontology lacks a distinction. Free to detect: it regroups mappings already computed.

      

        
LabelColumns

    


    

      
Overlap with the loaded studies

      
Jaccard on shared ontology labels — one of the seven dimensions in the full compatibility matrix, and the load-bearing one. It is the only dimension computable from a file alone; the other six need study-level metadata a dropped file does not carry.

      

    


  


  

    Runs the same modules as the pipeline: utils/tripwire.py, utils/codebook.py, utils/describe.py, utils/collisions.py, and the ontology .npz at the pipeline's own 0.65 threshold. No BigQuery, no GCS, no credentials — a demo does not need the warehouse, and a page reachable from a link should not hold keys. Uploaded files are written to a temporary directory that is deleted when the request ends.
